_note: Our own PLACEHOLDER soldiers. The rules are the book's rules for unmounted characters (Core p.74 Fighting on the Ground: Grit to attacks and saves, Biological, attack with Fight, don't Engage or block mechs) and Size (Core p.59: humans are Size 1/2). Weapons and gear are the book's pilot gear (data/lancer-data/pilot_gear.json). The numbers (HP, Grit by tier, defenses) are placeholders: the book's Human and Squad NPC templates are in the full core book's GM section, which our free copy doesn't have (docs/RULES_TODO.md 'Soldiers'). Roles are the book's NPC roles; a squad's job is only what its gear and actions allow (unmounted characters can't aid mechs, Core p.74, so no squad repairs mechs).

rifle_squad.name: Rifle Squad
rifle_squad.job: Ten soldiers with rifles. They close to rifle range and shoot.

missile_team.name: Missile Team
missile_team.job: A crew with a heavy launcher. They fire from as far away as they can, keep line of sight and stay out of reach.

guard_squad.name: Guard Squad
guard_squad.job: Soldiers who hold a place: they stay on or near what they guard and fight from cover.

spotter_team.name: Spotter Team
spotter_team.job: Scouts who stay hidden and Search for hidden enemies.

medic_team.name: Medic Team
medic_team.job: Medics who stay hidden and patch up people on foot (they can't repair mechs: Core p.74).

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.job: One soldier on foot (a guard, a sentry, an officer).
